svg.title: coderprint: 418k lines of code in use, of 509k written, all time
svg.desc: 417,819 lines of code in use (258,376 in production, 159,443 in tests), of 508,931 written (all time, charted since 27APR2026): 1,532 commits across all branches, 38 active days, a longest streak of 23 days, a current streak of 23 days, and 4 languages written. They came in 2 bursts of 34k and 474k lines of code. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 70%, TypeScript 12%, Python 10%, JavaScript 7%, other languages under 1%.
